reason: The radio is 18x18 on both states, but each has an equivalent control that meets 24x24. On settings.invite-role it is the 494x68 role header button, which selects the same role. On billpay.edit-recipient-details it is the 130x50 Business card label, wired to the radio by for/id, so a click anywhere on it selects the radio. On invite-role the sweep's own check passes the radio by spacing (279.55px) where axe reported 18px, and axe passes the billpay radio.

The 18x18 radio sits inside its role header button, which is 494x68, measures 24+ on both sampled states and selects the same role (Enter on it checked the radio and opened its panel). The sweep's own check also passes the radio by spacing on both states (clear circle 279.55px and 68px), where axe reported 18px.
